This site is a place to collect my research, publications, reusable code, teaching material, and short notes on marine ecology, climate change, conservation planning, and reproducible data science.

Over time, I plan to use this space for:

- plain-language summaries of new papers
- reusable R workflows
- workshop material
- project notes
- reflections on conservation science and career transitions

The goal is simple: make the work easier to find, understand, reuse, and share.
